**Call chain**

1. **Frontend trigger:** `onSubmit` in the allergy form workspace builds the payload and calls `saveAllergy` when not editing (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:349-383`, call at line 380). `saveAllergy` is imported from `./allergy-form.resource` (line 37-41).
2. **Frontend request:** `saveAllergy` in `allergy-form.resource.ts` calls `openmrsFetch` with `POST ${restBaseUrl}/patient/${patientUuid}/allergy` and the JSON payload (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.resource.ts:136-145`).
3. **Server REST handler:** `PatientAllergyResource2_0.save(Allergy)` links each reaction back to the allergy, then calls `Context.getPatientService().saveAllergy(...)` and re-reads the saved allergy by UUID (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs2_0/PatientAllergyResource2_0.java:250-260`). I did not open the generic create dispatch in the REST framework that routes the POST to `save`, so that hop is inferred from the `DelegatingResourceHandler#save` javadoc.
4. **Core service:** `PatientServiceImpl.saveAllergy` delegates to the DAO (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/PatientServiceImpl.java:1564-1568`). The interface declaration is at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/PatientService.java:965`.
5. **Data access / DB write:** `PatientDAO.saveAllergy` is declared at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/PatientDAO.java:299`. The Hibernate implementation calls `sessionFactory.getCurrentSession().persist(allergy)` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernatePatientDAO.java:1009-1013`).
